subspace_interface: build_noise_subspace(psi,gram,density_coefficients,active_coordinates,hamiltonian,forces,apply_extra,*,extra_rank) returns numeric projected frame,original Gram/D/R,projected H/Hadjoint and force/true-adjoint matrices,extra basis and inverse sqrtGram,all raw singular/state eigenvalues,measured projection diagnostics and metadata. hamiltonian/forces are existing ActionFactors; apply_extra(name,vectors,adjoint=False) applies actual physical operator only to NEW extra columns. Name 'hamiltonian' and force mapping keys select callbacks. No original H/F action replay.
subspace_method: Retain the ENTIRE admitted original raw column span,not twelve bands alone. Q0=Psi S^(-1/2). Let C0=S^(1/2) D S^(1/2), and choose extra directions by the SVD of complementary force/adjoint actions weighted by |C0|^(1/2). Absolute eigenvalues are a basis-selection proxy only;do not change original D,clip eigenvalues or claim a physical tail bound. Preserve all singular values,selected count and discarded proxy. Orthogonalize only requested extra vectors against original span. Project all four H/Hadjoint/F/Fadjoint blocks independently using cached original actions plus callbacks only on extra vectors. No full PW-square matrices;do not save a copied full raw Q0 bank.
bath_interface: integrate_filtered_operators(hamiltonian,forces,force_adjoints,segment_bounds,modal_chebyshev) returns integrated operators[probe,basis,basis],independently supplied-adjoint integrated operators,and raw Hamiltonian/eigenpair/adjoint diagnostics. Force arrays are [mode,basis,basis],coefficients [segment,degree,mode,probe].
bath_method: Literal initial projected H is held fixed as an EXPLICIT comparator approximation;the original state may be nonstationary and MUST NOT be diagonalized/refilled or assumed commuting with H. For every existing degree7 interval integrate a_mode(t) exp(+i H t) F_mode exp(-i H t). Convert small Chebyshev polynomials to Legendre coefficients and use integral P_n(x)exp(i z x)dx=2 i^n spherical_jn(n,z),with interval Jacobian/phase exactly once. Handle zero/negative energy gaps stably. Use actual independent force adjoints and conjugated scalar weights for the adjoint leg. Keep raw H Hermiticity/eigenpair defects;no Hermitization/clipping. No stationary FDT or temperature fit.
pilot: Parent executes owning oracles only AFTER all mathematical code slices settle,then one source0/two-ionic-mode/initial extra_rank8 material comparator,CPU7/BLAS1/Native4GiB/swap0/600s. Mode0/H actions are reused from the actual packet;mode1 is one necessary new physical force/adjoint pair. Retain original state/cross terms and all basis diagnostics. Extra_rank8 is an explicit pilot approximation,not a material acceptance gate or resolved error bound.
scope: A source0,selected-force-mode,finite-basis nonstationary frozen-initial-H comparator. Not a full moving/RPA passive closure,all128/64q,physical loss,lattice ranking or campaign completion. No finite-dose trajectory replay,preparation,DFT,population refill or original-data deletion. One shared reported5GiB filesystem;small extra basis/projected matrices only,no copied full-state/all-source bank.
